sloka: पद्म सौगन्धिक वहम् शिवम् शोक विनाशनम् ।धन्या लक्ष्मण सेवन्ते पम्पाया वन मरुतम् ॥४-१-१०४॥
transliteration: padma saugandhika vaham śivam śoka vināśanam ।dhanyā lakṣmaṇa sevante pampāyā vana marutam ॥4-1-104॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana blessed are those who enjoy the breeze filled with fragrance of lotuses of the surrounding forests of Pampa. The gentle and auspicious breeze indeed takes away the sorrow of the mind.
